query:
SELECT e.id, e.description, e.amount, e.supplierId, p.id as partnerId, p.tradeName
FROM expenses e
LEFT JOIN partners p ON e.supplierId = p.id
WHERE e.description LIKE '%Pacotes%' OR e.description LIKE '%5Kg%'
ORDER BY e.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 5
